Rashi on Sotah 42a:10:1.english: Neighing of horses - The snorting of horses is called tzahalah in the language of Scripture.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:10:3.hebrew: הגפת תריסין - מגיפין וסוגרין ומדבקין התריסין זה סמוך לזה, כדי שינקשו זה על זה, והקול נשמע כקול המון לאיים על שכנגדם:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:10:3.english: Closing of shields - They close, shut, and press the shields close to one another so that they knock against one another, and the sound is heard like the sound of a multitude, to intimidate those opposite them.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:11:1.english: Shobach - Commander of the army of Hadarezer.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:12:1.english: What is it saying - How does it derive [the requirement of] the sacred tongue from here?

Rashi on Sotah 42a:13:1.hebrew: דומיא דשוטר - תירוצא היא. השופט ממונה על השוטר, ששוטר עשוי לנגוש את מי שיצוה השופט לכוף:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:13:1.english: Similar to an officer - This is an answer. The judge is appointed over the officer, for an officer is designated to press whomever the judge commands to compel.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:14:1.hebrew: ואימא סגן - מדבר דברים הללו, דהא ממונה הוא ויש ממונה על גביו:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:14:1.english: Then say [that] the deputy [High Priest] - speaks these words, for he is an appointed [official] and there is an appointed [official] above him.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:14:2.english: Why is the deputy appointed - For what purpose is he appointed and prepared?

Rashi on Sotah 42a:14:3.hebrew: שאם אירע כו' - אבל בעוד שלא אירע פסול לכהן גדול, אין לסגן גדולה של כלום:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:14:3.english: That if [some disqualification] befalls, etc. - However, as long as no disqualification has befallen the High Priest, the deputy has no rank of any kind.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:15:1.english: What is different [about] “Hear, Israel” - Why does he begin with this expression?

Rashi on Sotah 42a:16:1.english: He speaks with them twice, once at the border - When they depart from their land.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:1:1.hebrew: ויהי הוא בשער בנימין - לאחר כמה ימים היה ירמיה יוצא מירושלים ללכת ארץ בנימין לחלוק נחלה שנפלה לו, ותפסו יראיה ויאמר לו, אל הכשדים אתה נופל:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:1:1.english: And he was in the gate of Benjamin - After several days, Jeremiah was going out from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to divide an inheritance that had fallen to him, and Irijah seized him and said to him: "You are falling [i.e., defecting] to the Chaldeans."

Rashi on Sotah 42a:2:1.hebrew: גמולה - בדולה, כמו ויגמל (בראשית כא):
Rashi on Sotah 42a:2:1.english: Separated [gemula] - Set apart [bedula], as in "and he was weaned [vayigamal]" (Genesis 21:8).

Rashi on Sotah 42a:5:1.english: He withdrew His hand - The Holy One, Blessed be He, [withdrew His hand] from being with scoffers.

Rashi on Sotah 42a:6:1.hebrew: לא יגורך רע - לא יגור עמך רע. וגבי מספרי לשון הרע כתיב, דכתיב בההוא פרשתא "כי אין בפיהו נכונה וגו'":
Rashi on Sotah 42a:6:1.english: Evil shall not sojourn with You - Evil shall not dwell with You. And it is written regarding speakers of evil speech, as it is written in that passage: "For there is no sincerity in their mouth, etc."

Rashi on Sotah 42a:8:1.hebrew: משוח מלחמה - כהן שנתרבה לכך, שנאמר: ונגש הכהן וגו'. ובגמרא פריך: מאי קאמר:
Rashi on Sotah 42a:8:1.english: [The priest] anointed for war - A priest who was anointed for this [purpose], as it is stated: "and the priest shall approach, etc." And in the Gemara it asks: What is [the Mishnah] saying?

Rashi on Sotah 42a:9:1.hebrew: ויקומו האנשים - כתיב גבי פקח בן רמליהו שנלחם עם אחז בדברי הימים, ששבו מבני יהודה הרבה. ושם היה נביא עודד שמו, והוכיחם לבני ישראל ואמר להם: בחמת ה' על בני יהודה נתנם בידכם והכיתם בהם לאין מרפא, ועתה אתם אומרים לכבוש אותם לעבדים? שמעוני והשיבו את השביה וגו':
Rashi on Sotah 42a:9:1.english: And the men rose up - [This] is written regarding Pekah son of Remaliah, who fought against Ahaz in Chronicles, that they took many captives from the children of Judah. And there was a prophet there whose name was Oded, and he rebuked the children of Israel and said to them: "In the wrath of the Lord against the children of Judah, He delivered them into your hand, and you struck them beyond healing; and now you say [you will] subdue them as slaves? Listen to me and return the captives, etc."

Rashi on Sotah 42a:9:2.english: For every feeble [one] - All the feeble ones among them, who are unable to walk on their feet.

Tosafot on Sotah 42a:12:1.hebrew: הכי קאמר שנאמר ודבר - ירושלמי: למה? בגין דכתי' "ודבר"? הרי ק"ש, דכתי' בה "ודברת בם", והיא נאמרת בכל לשון! אלא בגין דכתיב בה אמירה? הרי פרשת ודוי מעשר, הרי כתיב בה אמירה, והיא נאמרת בכל לשון! אמר רבי חגי: נאמר כאן הגשה, ונאמר להלן הגשה: "ונגשו הכהנים בני לוי". מה נגישה שנא' להלן בלשון קודש — אף כאן בלשון קודש. עד כדון כרבי עקיבא, דאמר לשונות ריבויין הן; כרבי ישמעאל, דאמר לשונות כפולין הן, ברם מאי? אמר ר' חייא בר אבא: נאמר כאן נגישה, ונאמר להלן נגישה: "ונגש משה אל הערפל". מה לשם לשון הקודש — אף כאן לשון הקודש. מסתברא דלא: "ופקדו שרי צבאות בראש העם", ואחרי כן "ונגש הכהן ודבר אל העם" — בתר דמתקן להון הוא משמע לון:
Tosafot on Sotah 42a:12:1.english: "This is what [the Mishnah] is saying: As it is stated, 'And speak'" - Jerusalem Talmud: Why [must the priest speak in the sacred tongue]? Because it is written, "And he shall speak"? Behold, the recitation of Shema, in which it is written, "And you shall speak of them," yet it may be recited in any language! Rather, because "saying" is written in it? Behold, the section of the tithe confession, behold, "saying" is written in it, yet it may be recited in any language! Rabbi Chaggai said: "Approaching" is stated here, and "approaching" is stated there: "And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall approach." Just as the approaching stated there is in the sacred tongue, so too here it is in the sacred tongue. Thus far [this follows] Rabbi Akiva, who says [repeated] expressions are inclusions; according to Rabbi Yishmael, who says expressions are [merely] doubled, however, what [is the source]? Rabbi Chiya bar Abba said: "Approaching" is stated here, and "approaching" is stated there: "And Moses approached the thick darkness." Just as there [it was] in the sacred tongue, so too here [it is] in the sacred tongue. It stands to reason that [the events do] not [occur in the order written in the Torah]: [First,] "And they shall appoint commanders of the hosts at the head of the people," and afterwards, "And the priest shall approach and speak to the people" — after he organizes them, he makes them hear [his words].

Tosafot on Sotah 42a:14:1.hebrew: סגן לאו ממונה הוא - ואם תאמר: הא אמרינן בסנהדרין פרק כהן גדול (סנהדרין דף יט.): "כשהוא מנחם אחרים, כל העם עוברין זה אחר זה, והממונה ממצעו", ותניא: "כשהוא עומד בשורה לנחם את האחרים, סגן ומשוח מלחמה עומד בימינו", ואמר רב פפא: "ש"מ מהא מתניתין תלת: שמע מינה היינו סגן היינו ממונה". יש לומר: ודאי ממונה היה לדברים שמינוהו אחיו הכהנים, כדתנן (יומא דף כח.): "אמר להם הממונה", אבל מן התורה אין לו שום מנוי ושררה יותר על אחיו הכהנים, ואינו אלא כעין מינוי אמרכל וגיזבר שגידלוהו אחיו הכהנים:
Tosafot on Sotah 42a:14:1.english: The deputy is not an appointed [office] - And if you will say: Behold, we say in Sanhedrin, in the chapter [entitled] Kohen Gadol (Sanhedrin 19a): "When he consoles others, all the people pass one after another, and the appointed one [memuneh] places him in the middle," and it was taught [in a baraita]: "When he stands in the row to console others, [the] deputy and [the priest] anointed for war stand at his right," and Rav Pappa said: "Learn from this Mishnah three things: learn from it [that] the deputy is the appointed one." One can say: Certainly he was appointed for matters to which his fellow priests appointed him, as we learned in a Mishnah (Yoma 28a): "The appointed one said to them," but by Torah law he has no appointment or authority greater than his fellow priests, and it is only like the appointment of an amarkal [temple trustee] and a gizbar [treasurer], whom his fellow priests elevated.
